name: Short Cut Macaroni & Cheese with Veggie Sausage, Tomatoes, and Snap Peas

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, add macaroni and cook, uncovered, until tender, 7-8 minutes. Drain and return to the pan, then add cheese sauce mix, milk, and butter. Stir well to combine and cook over medium heat until warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (206 g) box macaroni & cheese kit
¼ cup whole milk
2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add snap peas and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: While the snap peas are cooking, wash and dry tomatoes. Slice sausages crosswise into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (341 g) pkg cherry tomatoes
3 pre-cooked vegan sausage

instructions.primary_message: When the snap peas are starting to soften, add tomatoes and sausage slices to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender and sausage is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper to taste, remove from heat, and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide macaroni, veggies, and sausage between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
